name: Law firm intake
summary: A gated intake for a law firm: inquiry, conflict check, consultation, fee proposal, signed engagement with power of attorney and advance, and a written non-engagement letter for everyone who does not become a client.
description: Take clients on in a fixed order: every inquiry records its practice area, the earliest known time limit, the conflict check and who made it, then the consultation, the fee proposal and the signed engagement. A list of parties supports the conflict search, matters carry the power of attorney date and a retention date, and declined or silent prospects get a written non-engagement letter. It holds a pointer to the case, never case facts, privileged content, health data or opponents' details. It is not matter management, trust accounting, a procedural deadline authority or billing.

prompt.intro: Set up a law firm intake in my Customermates workspace: inquiries with a conflict check, the earliest known time limit, consultation, fee proposal and signed engagement, matters as pointers to the case system, parties for the conflict search and written non-engagement letters. Store no case facts or privileged content.
questions: Which practice areas do you take, and which do you refer out?
How do you run the conflict check, and who signs it off?
What fee models and what advance do you use?
Which case system do you use? Only a reference to the matter is kept here.
